# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Look at Rule 20 of the Building Regulations 2010 to understand that an inspector can exempt a building or part of a building from the Building Code and, especially, performance clauses of E2 External Fire Defence, E3 External Fire Spread and E4 Energy Efficiency.
3. Document the reason for exemption under rule 20 clearly on the accurate recording form.
3. As the building inspector, explain any matters covered under rule 20 to the applicant or agent in writing and give them an opportunity to respond within a reasonable time before finalising the accurate recording.
4. In addition to a brief summary of the extent of damage to the building and the repairs that have been done, use the accurate recording form to record:
   a. a statement that if an exemption under rule 20 is granted then the council won't be entering into a compliance agreement on this building or part of the building;
   b
